description: This file declares the ConnectionObserver interface for WebRTC streaming in Android's Cuttlefish project. The interface defines various virtual methods for handling device-specific events like input, display, sensor, and channel communications between the device and the streaming library.

classes.name: ConnectionObserver
classes.description: Abstract class that serves as the boundary between device-specific code and general WebRTC streaming logic, with methods for handling device events and communication channels.

classes.name: ConnectionObserverFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of ConnectionObserver.

methods.name: OnConnected
methods.description: Called when a connection has been established.

methods.name: OnMouseMoveEvent
methods.description: Handle mouse move events with x and y coordinates.

methods.name: OnTouchEvent
methods.description: Handle touch events with device label, position, and touch state.

methods.name: OnMultiTouchEvent
methods.description: Handle multi-touch events with labels, identifiers, positions, and state.

methods.name: OnKeyboardEvent
methods.description: Handle keyboard input events identified by keycode.

methods.name: OnAdbChannelOpen
methods.description: Handle opening of ADB communication channel, accepting a sender function.

methods.name: OnControlChannelOpen
methods.description: Handle opening of control communication channel, accepting a sender function.

methods.name: OnLidStateChange
methods.description: React to lid open/close state changes.

methods.name: OnHingeAngleChange
methods.description: React to hinge angle change events.

methods.name: OnVolumeDownButton
methods.description: React to volume down button press/release.

methods.name: OnVolumeUpButton
methods.description: React to volume up button press/release.

methods.name: OnCustomActionButton
methods.description: Handle custom action button events with command and state.

methods.name: OnCameraControlMsg
methods.description: Process camera control messages in JSON.

methods.name: OnDisplayControlMsg
methods.description: Process display control messages in JSON.

methods.name: OnBluetoothChannelOpen
methods.description: Handle opening of Bluetooth channel, accepting sender function.

methods.name: OnSensorsChannelOpen
methods.description: Handle opening of sensors channel, accepting sender function.

methods.name: OnLightsChannelOpen
methods.description: Handle lights channel opening, accepting sender function.

methods.name: OnLocationChannelOpen
methods.description: Handle location channel opening, accepting sender function.

methods.name: CreateObserver
methods.description: Factory method to create a new ConnectionObserver instance.
